recipe_note: Initial init/baseline used an external adapter of the same APIs; subsequent stages used the published recipe. Primary protocol and runtime were frozen before measured execution. The refinement was registered separately after the first candidate failed.

graph.sign_convention: dominant synapse-count-weighted presynaptic NT; GABA/GLUT inhibitory, ACH/DA/OCT/SER excitatory approximation

model.limitations: The current telemetry does not persist provider token usage or prove the exact local weight revision. Model calls are HTTP generation calls. llm_calls equals that count when model_calls is present; heuristic llm_calls counts cortex iterations. Native repeated_actions is habituation-specific; derived duplicate calls are reported separately and may be valid after edits.

scope: Existing synthetic software fixtures, not scientific acceptance, workflow completion or orchestration admission.

selection.refined_candidate: rejected for live use: toy-only improvement, 0/2 live tasks versus frozen 2/2, model-call exhaustion; no tournament held-out success
